subject.title: [Bug]: macos say command in daemon not output to speakers

question: What supported behavior should OpenClaw provide when macOS Local CLI TTS runs under a launchd-managed Gateway and the configured command needs the logged-in GUI user session to play through speakers?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the permanent answer affects daemon security expectations, docs, and whether this remains an operator-configured wrapper or becomes built-in plugin behavior.

options.title: Document wrapper path
options.body: Keep core/runtime behavior unchanged and document a robust `launchctl asuser` wrapper using the existing Local CLI provider config, with no hard-coded UID in the example.

options.title: Add plugin-owned helper
options.body: Implement a Local CLI/macOS helper that discovers the active GUI session and bridges playback while preserving file-output synthesis for channel delivery.

options.title: Declare unsupported
options.body: Document that managed macOS daemon installs synthesize files for OpenClaw delivery but do not guarantee speaker playback from headless or wrong-user launchd contexts.

recommendation.title: Document wrapper path
recommendation.body: Keep core/runtime behavior unchanged and document a robust `launchctl asuser` wrapper using the existing Local CLI provider config, with no hard-coded UID in the example.

likelyOwner.reason: This owner has the strongest combined trail across the adopted Local CLI provider/docs and adjacent launchd lifecycle behavior.
